function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
Cream‑colored clothes are a classic, versatile choice that can work well in many settings—whether you’re dressing for a casual day out, a semi‑formal event, or even a professional environment. Here are a few quick points to consider: | Factor | How Cream Works | |--------|-----------------| | **Neutrality** | Cream is a warm, off‑white shade that pairs nicely with both cool and warm tones. It’s less stark than pure white, so it’s easier on the eyes and can soften your look. | | **Skin Tone** | Cream tends to complement fair to medium skin tones beautifully. If you have a warmer undertone, cream can enhance your natural glow. For cooler undertones, you might want to add a hint of color (e.g., a jewel‑tone accessory) to keep the outfit lively. | | **Occasion** | • **Casual** – Cream chinos or a light‑weight tee can look relaxed yet polished.
• **Business/Professional** – A cream blazer or dress shirt offers a subtle, sophisticated alternative to navy or charcoal.
• **Formal** – Cream suits or gowns can feel elegant, especially when paired with metallic or pastel accents. | | **Season** | Cream is great for spring and summer because it reflects light. In fall or winter, pair it with richer hues (deep greens, burgundy, navy) to keep the look grounded. | | **Styling Tips** | • Add contrast with darker accessories (black, navy, charcoal).
• Layer with textured fabrics (linen, tweed, denim) to avoid a flat look.
• Use cream as a base and layer with pops of color or patterns to keep the outfit dynamic. | ### Quick Decision Guide 1. **What’s the event?** - Casual → Cream chinos + a crisp tee or polo. - Semi‑formal → Cream blazer + dress shirt + tie. - Formal → Cream suit or gown. 2. **What’s your skin tone?** - Warm undertone → Cream works beautifully; add gold jewelry. - Cool undertone → Cream still works, but consider adding a splash of color (emerald, sapphire) to brighten the look. 3. **Do you want a bold statement or a subtle look?** - Subtle: Stick to cream alone or pair with neutrals. - Bold: Pair cream with a contrasting color or pattern. If you’re still unsure, think about the vibe you want to convey and whether cream feels comfortable and flattering to you. Feel free to share more details—occasion, personal style, or any specific outfit ideas—and I can give more tailored suggestions!
